fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of an MSc in data science at Warwick? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 deadline.

Warwick has no plain Data Science MSc. The closest course is the **MSc Statistics with Data Science**. It is a one-year, full-time course starting on 27 September 2027. It is a statistics course for people with a strong maths background, not a computing course.

**The most important fact for you:** you need a 2:1 in statistics, maths or a science with high mathematical content. For an Indian degree, a 2:1 means **60%** to **70%**, depending on your institution's category.

You build a strong base in statistical theory and data science, then choose topics such as statistical learning and big data, Bayesian forecasting and Monte Carlo methods. You also build computing skills in areas such as high-performance computing, natural language processing and image and video analysis.

For the wider university, see our [University of Warwick page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-warwick).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a 2:1 undergraduate degree or equivalent in Statistics, Mathematics or a science with sufficiently high mathematical content. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade. Warwick expects you to have standard undergraduate knowledge of statistics and probability already.

**Indian marks.** Warwick sorts Indian institutions into three categories on its [India entry page](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/international/countryinformation/southasia/india/india-entry-requirements/). For this course the 2:1 line matters. A UK First Class needs at least **65%** (6.5 out of 10) from a Category 1 institution such as an IIT, IIM, IISER, IIIT or NIT, **75%** (7.5 out of 10) from Category 2 (State or Central), or **80%** (8.0 out of 10) from Category 3 (Private or Deemed). A 2:1 needs **60%** from Category 1, **65%** from Category 2 and **70%** from Category 3. Search the page for your institution to find its category. Distance-learning degrees are not accepted. If your transcript shows a percentage, Warwick uses it before any GPA.

**References.** Warwick typically asks for one academic reference.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. You need **IELTS 6.5** overall with no part below **6.0**.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Warwick's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for overseas students is **£39,330** for 2027-28. Warwick says tuition is payable for each year of your course, and this course lasts one year.

Warwick is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, 2027-28 | £39,330 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£51,591** |

The sum is £39,330 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £51,591. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule is **£1,171** for each month of your course outside London, up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row. The 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** The course page does not state a deposit amount, so none is added to the total. Ask Warwick before you accept your offer. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

No Warwick scholarship for Indian students is confirmed on this page. Warwick's scholarship search did not return results when it was read, so no award or amount is listed. Check the [Warwick scholarships page](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/scholarships-and-bursaries/scholarships/) and filter for postgraduate taught, overseas and India before you apply.

## Deadlines and intakes

Warwick's on-time deadline for taught postgraduate courses starting in September or October 2027 is **2 August 2027**. Late applications are still accepted, but Warwick cannot guarantee they will be processed in time to finish admissions. If you apply late, send your degree certificates, transcripts and English evidence at once, and make sure your referee can reply fast. Teaching starts on **27 September 2027**. A January start is not shown.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** Find your institution's category on Warwick's India page and compare your percentage with the 2:1 line.
2. **Apply online.** Start from the [course page](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/courses/msc-statistics-data-science/). Aim to apply before the on-time deadline of **2 August 2027**.
3. **Send your documents.** Include your degree certificates, transcripts and English test evidence, and give your referee's email address so Warwick can contact them.
4. **Ask about the deposit.** Warwick's page does not state one.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.


## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you have a statistics, maths or science degree with strong maths
- your percentage meets the 2:1 line for your institution category
- you want a statistics-led data science course

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is mainly computing with little maths, because the course expects statistics and probability knowledge
- you need a confirmed scholarship, because none is confirmed here
- you need a January start, because only September 2027 is shown

faq_json.q: How much does the Warwick MSc Statistics with Data Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £39,330 for 2027-28. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the first year comes to £51,591 before any scholarship.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need for Warwick Statistics with Data Science?
faq_json.a: The course asks for a 2:1. For India, a UK 2:1 means 60% from Category 1 institutions, 65% from Category 2 and 70% from Category 3.

faq_json.q: Does Warwick need GRE for MSc Statistics with Data Science?
faq_json.a: The course page does not mention GRE. It asks for IELTS 6.5 overall with no part below 6.0 and one academic reference.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for Warwick Statistics with Data Science 2027?
faq_json.a: The on-time deadline for September and October 2027 starts is 2 August 2027. Late applications are accepted but may not finish in time.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Warwick?
faq_json.a: No Warwick scholarship is confirmed on this page. Warwick's scholarship search did not return results, so check its scholarships page directly.
